name: @causeway-services/turntide-islands
description: The public Turntide Islands site, built with VICTOR.

scripts.build: npm run derive && static-site-publisher build content dist --config=./static-site-publisher.config.mjs
scripts.check: npm run derive && static-site-publisher check content --config=./static-site-publisher.config.mjs
scripts.serve: npm run derive && static-site-publisher serve content --port=8561 --config=./static-site-publisher.config.mjs
